key_insight: RoboArchitect automatically improves robotic manipulation by evolving the control harness and persistent memory around a frozen policy, without updating model weights.
engineering_relevance: Automated harness design offers an alternative to policy finetuning when adapting robots to new tasks or environments.
method: A coding model observes robot rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises control code.
The harness coordinates policy queries, vision tools, and direct arm commands.
Persistent memory carries learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions.
evidence_signal: Across multiple benchmarks and policies, average success rose from 9.7% to 43.3% on held-out scenes and from 12.7% to 40.2% on held-out tasks.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify optimization cost or safety requirements for executing automatically generated robot-control code.
paper_title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
